theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  constructor <;> intro s' ht <;> cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    cases ht with
    | choiceL ht =>
      first
      | refine Exists.imp ?_ (h.follow_fst ht)
      | refine Exists.imp ?_ (h.follow_snd ht)
      intro t hb
      exact ⟨Tr.choiceL hb.1, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb.2⟩
    | choiceR ht =>
      exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim h =>
    grind only [→ Bisimilarity.follow_fst, → Bisimilarity.follow_snd, → ChoiceBisim.bisim]
